description: Integration release expanding Accounting Management, Billing and Cashier, Blood Bank, Inpatient, Radiology, Number Series, and guarantor capabilities. Includes accounting period and year-end closing, recurring journals and posting rules, billing payer-edit and petty-cash enhancements, blood-bank workflows, inpatient assignment and clinical-context improvements, radiology reporting and numbering, canonical Reg/Phm table-prefix normalization, and EF migration metadata repairs.
